spec.name: sprint35_qhour_open_taker_imbalance_liquid
spec.hypothesis: Opening-15min directional signal (qhour_open), confirmed by taker order-flow imbalance, predicts short-horizon returns in liquid mega-caps once slippage is controlled for (unlike the illiquid altbasket that failed twice).
spec.power_argument: 12 liquid symbols x ~25 trading days x entry_per_day_cap=1 = up to 300 opportunities; sized to hit the charter's >=300-trade floor. Min detectable net edge ~15bps at alpha=0.05 given T1 fee tier (~2bps RT) and observed open-window return dispersion from sprint32/34 data — same methodology, smaller n so higher required effect size than the 34-36bps null already ruled out on illiquid names.
